title: Accounts Memorandum — Portfolio Point Count, Licence Volume Steps and the Annual Fee of a Building Automation Service Plan
content:
# Accounts Memorandum — Portfolio Point Count, Licence Volume Steps and the Annual Fee of a Building Automation Service Plan

**Basis.** Where one owner holds Building Automation Service Plans at several buildings, the licence position is settled across the portfolio before any single plan is priced. The owner's covered points are the sum of the covered points over their plans standing in active or pending renewal status, the plan being priced included; plans in quoted, suspended, expired, cancelled or declined status are not counted. The per-point licence fee of each plan is read from that plan's own tier, never from the portfolio's largest tier, and the portfolio count decides only which volume step the licence sits on. Points beyond a plan's covered maximum are charged the tier's point overage fee for the remainder of the plan year, prorated by whole months, and they are added to the covered count at the next true-up rather than immediately.

**Volume steps.** The portfolio point bands are 0 to 2000 points, 2001 to 8000 points, and above 8000 points.

| Portfolio covered points | Volume step |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2000 | first band |
| 2001 to 8000 | second band |
| above 8000 | third band |

**Annual fee of one plan.** The annual fee of a plan is the tier's annual plan fee, plus the points covered beyond the tier's covered maximum (nil where there are none) multiplied by the tier's point overage fee, plus the tier's annual secure remote access gateway fee, the total rounded to two decimal places. The tier's covered maximum, point overage fee and licence fee per point are those of the plan's own tier as the tier schedule states them.

**Worked memorandum figures (hypothetical).** An owner holds an active plan of 1500 points and a pending-renewal plan of 900 points, and a suspended plan of 400 points. The portfolio count is 1500 plus 900, that is 2400 points, which sits in the second band; the suspended plan's 400 points are left out. If one of those plans covers 60 points more than its tier's covered maximum at a point overage fee of 7 USD, its annual fee carries 60 multiplied by 7 USD, that is 420 USD, on top of the tier's annual plan fee and gateway fee.

**Counting boundary.** A portfolio of exactly 2000 points sits in the first band; a portfolio of 2001 points sits in the second; 8000 points sits in the second and 8001 in the third.
